summary: Playable card faces are now read from Content/catalogue-art.zip (already holds all 2,208 at 750x1050) through new CardFaces.cs; the exported game no longer carries a second converted copy (Content/Published/oracle-l5r-* excluded in both export presets). Windows zip 1.51 GB -> 1.01 GB. Development checkouts fall back to the JPG when the pack is absent. CardTile.Artwork, CatalogueData's pinned printing and the DuelScreen reveal prefetch use the pack. Option 3 (raw JPGs) is subsumed: no converted copy of the faces remains.
validation: dotnet build 0 errors; fresh tools/export.sh windows (pck 1.45 GB -> 0.94 GB, zip 1.01 GB); the EXPORTED exe, which lacks the JPGs, drew all faces correctly in a native 1672x941 tutorial capture. Faces are now WebP q85 from the pack instead of near-lossless; not compared side by side beyond that capture. No hand-played match.
remaining: Pack faces are q85 WebP: if a card looks soft on the big inspector, raise quality in the pack rebuild. Windows graphical check of the extracted package and a published release not done.
